speaker: Mysterious Person
text: Leave me be. This is my domain.

speaker: Nina
text: (Wow, they seem like a ray of sunshine.) Well, alright, I’ll just be going then.

speaker: Mysterious Person
text: (Sigh) Who are you? Why are you here?

speaker: Nina
text: Oh, I’m Nina. I just wanted to know what this mystical cave was all about. Who are you?

speaker: Nina
text: (stunned) Wow. Fancy name. More importantly, are you a flipping dragon?

speaker: Taz
text: Are you making fun of me?

speaker: Taz
text: And it’s a good thing you weren’t, or I would have had to breathe fire. My rage knows no bounds. Nothing can quell it once I am angered. Nothing but coffee.

speaker: Taz
text: Hm. I guess the coffee was okay. I suppose. You should meet me at the Perpetually Stormy Climactic Field.
